newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Senate to vote on privatization bill.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Senate to vote on privatization bill.

text.p: A bill which would give Brazil's Congress powers to remove companies from the country's privatization program was due to be put to a vote in the Senate later Tuesday, a congressional official said.

The official said the bill, aimed principally at stopping the privatization of mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), would be included in a voting session due to begin at 1430 local/1630 GMT.
The bill, written by Sen. Jose Eduardo Dutra of the left-wing Workers Party, was defeated last month in a Senate committee.

But Dutra took advantage of congressional rules to get his legislation onto the floor of the upper house for a vote. News reports said government leaders would seek to stall the bill by sending it to another committee.
